[center][color=#ffae00][size=5][b]Ghibli Creature Pack for Nature In The Valley[/b][/size]
[size=2][i]By XanCreations[/i][/size][/color][/center]
[center][b]Version:[/b] 1.0.0 • [b]Updated:[/b] 2025-05-27

[b]Description:[/b]  
Adds Studio Ghibli creatures to Nature In The Valley.

[b]Features:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Nine new roaming creatures, each with unique sprites & spawn conditions  
[*] Fully integrated via Pathoschild’s Content Patcher  
[*] Terrariumable & donatable at the museum  
[*] [b]Framework required:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url]
[/list]
[b]Entities:[/b]  
[spoiler]

[b]Installation:[/b]  
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url].  
[*] Copy the [b][CP] NITV Ghibli[/b] folder into your ‘Mods’ directory:  
[code]StardewValley\Mods\[CP] NITV Ghibli[/code]  
[*] Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]Configuration:[/b]  
Added a config that utilises [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change rarity in-game.

If you encounter issues or have feedback, leave a comment!  
This is my first mod so thank you for downloading!
NOTE: I am currently working on a Pokemon mod for NITV - this mod is something small I did while I am working on that.
